note: Fixed eval set for the AI counsellor. Each entry maps to acceptance criteria in docs/ai-counsellor/2026-08-20-ai-counsellor-v2-gap-analysis-and-plan.md. Checks are STRUCTURAL only — they verify the shape of a reply (did it ask something, did it cite, did it emit a card), never whether the content is good. Answer quality is read by a human from the report. Checks that depend on a populated corpus (cites, card) will fail until the knowledge rack and course data are seeded — that gap is the signal, not a bug in the harness.

checks.asks_question: reply contains a question, or a quick_replies block
checks.no_question_only: reply is not just a question — it answered something too
checks.cites: at least one source event arrived
checks.card: at least one course-card was emitted
checks.block: at least one interactive block was emitted
checks.admits_gap: reply says it does not have the data, rather than inventing it
checks.no_reask_budget: reply does not ask again for a budget the student already gave
